features.title: Spellblade
features.text: Combine martial attacks with prepared arcane spells. Your hybrid study shapes how you fight and which defensive or movement tools support your routine.

features.title: Spellstrike
features.text: Deliver a spell alongside a weapon attack, then recharge before using Spellstrike again. Balance that sequence with movement, defenses and Arcane Cascade.

review.notes: Editorial assessment of the class framework and ordinary builds. Rules references support mechanics; scores remain judgments.

ratings.offense: 5 → 4–5. Spellstrike combines weapon damage and spells; recharge and movement affect sustained output.
ratings.defense: 3 → 2.5–4. Hybrid study, shields and spell choices alter defenses.
ratings.support: 2 → 2–3. Arcane spells can support allies, but compete with the actions used for Spellstrike.
ratings.utility: 2.5 → 2.5–3.5. Prepared arcane spells offer selected answers beyond weapon combat.
ratings.difficulty: 3.5 → 4. Spellstrike, recharge, movement and spell preparation compete for a tight action budget.
